tasks.name: Five-second readiness
tasks.successMetric: After a 5-second home exposure, identifies preparation and one valid reason; accuracy is no lower than the current UI

tasks.name: Current weather versus forecast
tasks.successMetric: Distinguishes current clear weather from future rain and locates the forecast time and probability

tasks.name: Departure action
tasks.successMetric: Reads departure time and preparation reason, then selects map directions without inferring unsupported routes

tasks.name: Data availability and alerts
tasks.successMetric: Distinguishes missing or stale data from normal weather and explains an alert and available action; zero false-live interpretations

tasks.name: Reduced mode parity
tasks.successMetric: Makes the same decision in static, reduced motion/transparency and large-text variants; zero important information loss

tasks.name: WeatherON identity
tasks.successMetric: Groups candidate home/detail/departure screens without logo, product name or motion and explains shared form/hierarchy beyond color alone

comparison.baseline: Current WeatherON UI with identical content and data
comparison.report: Success counts and median time; round required success count up
comparison.identityControl: Generic matte cards with matched theme; supplementary grayscale comparison

blockingFailures: Missing or sample data interpreted as live normal weather
Important information lost in an accessibility variant
